AI is revolutionizing the restaurant and food service industries. Consumers are paying more attention to where their food comes from, how safe it is, and if it was sourced responsibly. They want to align themselves with businesses that focus on safety, ethics, sustainability, and responsibility. AI is improving communication, transparency, and traceability between restaurants and customers, giving them the info they need to trust them.
